paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your enquiry about a digital learning workshop. I am writing to provide the information you requested. I hope the following details will help you make the necessary arrangements.

Thank you for your enquiry about
a digital learning workshop
. I am writing to provide the information you requested. I hope the following details will help you make the necessary arrangements.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

Thank you for your enquiry about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am writing to provide the information you requested. I hope the following details will help you make the necessary arrangements.

paragraphs.label: Thông tin thứ nhất
paragraphs.text: First of all, the event will take place at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. Participants will have the opportunity to try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules. The programme is intended to provide a practical introduction to smartphones in the classroom.
